# Musical Ranking Crawler Project Instructions

This project crawls musical ranking data from Interpark and Yes24 websites.

## Project Overview
- **Purpose**: Collect musical popularity charts and detailed information
- **Target Sites**: 
  - Interpark: https://tickets.interpark.com/contents/ranking?genre=MUSICAL
  - Yes24: https://ticket.yes24.com/Rank/Musical
- **Data to Collect**:
  - Weekly/Monthly rankings
  - Musical ratings
  - Image URLs
  - Show detail page URLs
  - Performance periods
  - Booking rates
  - Casting information

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python for web scraping
- Implement proper error handling and rate limiting
- Structure data collection in modular components
- Include data validation and cleaning
- Export results to CSV/JSON formats
- Follow ethical scraping practices

## Code Style
- Use descriptive variable names
- Add docstrings to functions and classes
- Implement logging for debugging
- Handle exceptions gracefully
- Use type hints where appropriate
